name: meeting-action-items
description: Extract structured action items from meeting notes with an LLM step, then format the list — showcasing OpenSOP's reliability story for agentic extraction. Pass notes as a process input; no interactive form required.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.description: Raw meeting notes to extract action items from. Pass via --input notes="..." (required for meaningful results).

inputs.name: meeting_title
inputs.description: Optional title for the meeting (used in the output header).

steps.description: Extract action items with owner and task from the meeting notes.
Format the action item list as a Markdown checklist.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  (if ((."extract-actions".items) | type) == "array" then ."extract-actions".items else [] end) as $items |
  "## Action Items — " + ((.meeting_title // "Meeting") | tostring) + "\n" +
  (if ($items | length) == 0 then
    "_No action items found._"
  else
    [ $items[] |
      if type == "object" then "- [ ] **" + ((.owner // "(unassigned)") | tostring) + ":** " + ((.task // "(no task)") | tostring)
      else "- [ ] " + (. | tostring) end
    ] | join("\n")
  end)
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{action_items: .}'
